description: This Python source file defines the ResponsesIDSecurity class, which manages security checks and encryption/decryption of response IDs within the responses handling process of a FastAPI-based proxy server. It includes hooks for pre-call processing, response ID encryption, and response ID security enforcement, specifically tailored to respond ID access control and obscuration.

classes.name: ResponsesIDSecurity
classes.description: A class providing mechanisms for response ID security, including encrypting, decrypting, and access verification for response identifiers in a proxy context.
